docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Seven years in a Swiss sanatorium on the eve of the First World War.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Thomas Mann (1875–1955), Der Zauberberg (1924, German), translated by H. T. Lowe-Porter (1876–1963), 1927. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from the Internet Archive. Modified: converted to this format.
